caption:
Boat tour from Funchal, Madeira: two white glasses, one ice bucket and a wake doing its best.

The back corner of our boat is in the bottom right. Two white wine glasses stand on the white edge, next to a bucket with a bottle in it. They are not wobbling. We would like to say that is skill, but the water is just kind in this picture.

Behind them, the wake is a messy white scribble on deep blue water. Further on, the city climbs the green hills in layers of small buildings, with a long flat harbour wall along the shore. The sky above is clear blue and empty.

The practical bit: our Day Trip and our Sunset Trip both leave from Funchal marina and follow this coast. The boat is private, with a skipper, five guests at most, and nobody else on board. Food on board, photos with a real camera and Insta360 video come with every trip.

O brinde já está pronto.

Which would you look at first, the glasses or the hills?
